Name: TC-TIME_004 (positive) : Generate employee report using valid filters
Precondition:
PRE-CONDITIONS
* Navigate to the OrangeHRM

system.
* Ensure that the user is logged in with a valid Admin or Employee
account.
* Ensure that employee time records already exist in the database.
* Access to the module:
Time > Reports > Employee Reports

REQUIREMENTS
* System shall allow users to access the Employee Reports module.
* System shall accept valid report filters and employee information.
* System shall generate the employee report successfully.
* System shall display the report data according to the selected
filters.
* System shall maintain the appropriate interface layout, colors, and
design standards.
EXPECTED RESULTS
The system should successfully generate and display the Employee Report
using the selected valid filters and employee data. The displayed
information must correspond to the applied search criteria without errors
or inconsistencies.
Objective:
This test case verifies that the system successfully generates and displays
an Employee Report when valid employee data and report filters are provided
in the OrangeHRM system. The test ensures that the reporting functionality
works correctly and that the displayed information matches the selected
criteria.
Expected Result:
* The OrangeHRM login page loads successfully.
* The login interface is displayed correctly.
* The user is authenticated successfully.
* The system redirects the user to the Dashboard page after login.

Name: TC-TIME_005 (Negative) :Verify system behavior with invalid report filters
Precondition:
PRE-CONDITIONS
* Navigate to the OrangeHRM

system.
* Ensure the user is logged in with a valid Admin or Employee account.
* Access the module:
Time > Reports > Employee Reports

REQUIREMENTS

System shall prevent report generation with invalid filters.
System shall display validation or warning messages when incorrect data is
inserted.
System shall return no records when the provided filters do not match
existing data.
System shall maintain proper interface layout, colors, and responsiveness
during validation


EXPECTED RESULTS
The system should display validation messages or return no matching records
when invalid employee data or incorrect report filters are used. The report
must not be generated with invalid information, and the interface should
remain stable and functional.

This test case verifies how the OrangeHRM system behaves when invalid
employee data or incorrect report filters are used during employee report
generation. The test make sure that the system validates incorrect inputs
properly and prevents invalid report generation.
Expected Result:
* The OrangeHRM login page loads successfully.
* The login interface is displayed correctly.
* The user is authenticated successfully.
* The system redirects the user to the Dashboard page after login.
